ui.hero.title: One platform for all the animals you look after
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your locations. Find any Antz task with real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Touch any card to open its guide with all the functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: In this guide every module is presented with its functions and real screens. Continue from where you left off, or write to us – we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day with Antz looks like
ui.day.1: Log in to your work space
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that match your organization and switch on permissions for each module separately, so that everyone sees what their work needs.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app is for work on site, for example notes, treatment, transfers and egg records. The web application is for work at a desk, for example the hospital system, hatchery (incubator room) setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on the phone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles used in your organization, for example zoologist, and switch on permissions for each module separately.
ui.faq.q4: We have more than one location. Will this work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps the data of all locations and departments in one place. Housing is organized by location, section and enclosure, and transfers between locations go through approval and security check-out [?].
ui.faq.a5: Start with the guide 'Beginning', then open the modules that your role uses. If anything is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The autopsy module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, organ findings and medical conclusions. It helps to determine the cause of death precisely, standardizes reports, ensures timely handling of carcasses, and complies with legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal or species; filter by location, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the transfer stages: incoming, waiting, drafts and completed. [?]
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, request submitter, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The deworming module helps to systematically record and monitor anti-parasitic treatment, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation and clear tracking of every deworming of every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings are divided into upcoming, waiting, missed and done, for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course or directly record the medicine administered, with set dates and information.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration logging
m.deworming.f3.desc: The dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and, optionally, a repeat examination are recorded.
m.housing.title: Holding places
m.housing.intro: The holding places module manages animal habitats across all your locations, sections and enclosures, so that the place of every animal is known and every change is tracked. Access at every level is granted according to permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Location administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit locations with role-based permissions for safe and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit zoo sections with permission-based control for safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each of them, in order to look after animals and data efficiently.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal death
m.fetal-death.intro: The fetal death module records and manages cases of fetal death in enclosures, capturing the cause, time and information on the related animals. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases: the cause, time, parents, animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by location, date, stillborn or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing records of the deceased
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: All information: days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, location, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs – from laying to hatching or transfer to the hatchery (incubator room), ensuring accurate records, real-time updates and full traceability, so that nest, hatchery and incubation teams coordinate their work better and are accountable.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg summary
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Numbers in real time: in nests, moved to the hatchery, marked to be thrown out.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / hatchery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the whole timeline of the egg's path.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administering medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The administration module supplements medical records, turning prescriptions into concrete treatment workflows. It enables real-time treatment of individual animals or their batches – in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for a chosen date without writing out the whole medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records and narrow the list by date, object, species or controlled substance. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatment by date in four tabs: waiting, administered, missed, discontinued.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the whole animal vaccination cycle – from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, waiting, missed and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of doses and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are divided into upcoming, waiting, missed and done, for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record the vaccine injected, with set dates and medicine information.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration logging
m.vaccination.f3.desc: The dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and, optionally, a repeat examination are recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Makes it possible to dispense medical products quickly, accurately and traceably directly to authorized doctors, ensuring timely fulfilment and automatic stock updating from prescription to shelf, with batch-level visibility and expiry tracking throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Summary
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insights into stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, consumption, expiry and fast-moving products, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (racks and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Manage storage by the number of racks and shelves for quick access and updates, with customizable data (packages, units of measurement, salts, drivers, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batches with value and expiry; mark low-stock or expired items; monitor approaching expiries; manage the deposit with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and validity, record purchases and dispatches, manage the common register, manage substitutes and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense medicines or collect them directly from the pharmacy – everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing shipments of medicines and fulfil them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, damaged, expired); keep the audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download consumption, returns, purchases and dispensing reports for finance and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: Beginning
m.getting-started.intro: The guide 'Beginning' presents the purpose of the app and introduces new users to the main steps: how to set up a profile, get acquainted with the main functions and navigate the platform efficiently.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and work spaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and reach the work environment assigned to you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home stream for news, quick navigation links and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Waiting autopsies / administrations / distributions
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals waiting for autopsy, administrative documents and further distribution or disposal procedures before the final closing of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Main settings and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure the master data and get acquainted with modules such as medical records, holding places, eggs, nutrition and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update the profile and change language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels required for safe work.
